entries.reason: the content source's player-layer half is this port's own picture-in-picture: AVPlayerLayer is exported on this release and AVPictureInPictureController.m already reparents one into its floating window, so the box holds the very layer that window uses. Its sample-buffer half is not carried, and the row of AVPictureInPictureSampleBufferPlaybackDelegate names that half
entries.effect: a source holds the player layer it was made with and reports it back; a source made with no layer is still a source, and the controller built from it reports no content source at all, because -isPictureInPicturePossible is computed from that layer's real readyForDisplay and player
entries.source: SDK 26.2 AVKit/AVPictureInPictureController.h:180-205; the armv7 cache of 6.1.3 carries AVPlayerLayer and its readyForDisplay
